Color sequence: with 14 games, colors alternate... Game 1: Gukesh White (Gukesh "drew with white in the second game"... wait — "Gukesh settled for a draw with white against Sindarov in the second game" — Game 2 Gukesh White. So Game 1: Sindarov White? "Sindarov, who faced the Berlin Endgame in his first ever world championship game" — Berlin is a Black defense... Hmm chess.com game 1 says "Sindarov faced the Berlin" — no wait the game-1 chess.com article says "Sindarov was even penalized two minutes for incorrectly claiming a draw". The Berlin endgame = Gukesh's defense with Black? "Gukesh with the white pieces"... bhaskarenglish: "The second game... Gukesh playing with the white pieces." So Game 2: Gukesh White, Sindarov Black. Game 1: Gukesh Black (faced Berlin with Black... actually Berlin Defense is for Black). So game 1: Sindarov White. Game 3 (Nov 26): Sindarov White "for the second time in the match".

Colors: games alternate pairs usually: 1,3,5... not simple. The official pairing rule needs the schedule page. worldchampionship.fide.com/schedule is JS. But the FACT SHEET says Game 3 Sindarov White. Game 4 Nov 28: probably Gukesh White? etc. For the note, what matters is Game 8's color. With alternation pattern B/W per game in a scrambling... The rule (since 2024): colors assigned in a published sequence. Hmm.
